draft.final_body:
29% of staked SOL went dark. Halt line: 33%.

A monitored threshold. Nobody positioned to act at 29.

Vanna's Guardian defends your 1.1× floor — policy-bounded, autonomous only within limits you set. Vanna never holds custody. Stellar testnet; liquidation remains possible.
thread: The gap was not visibility. The threshold was watched the whole way up. What was missing at 29 was an actor with a mandate — something standing at the line with permission to move before the line was crossed.

How that works here: you set the floor, and the guardian defends it within your policy — autonomous only within limits you set, never outside them. Scoped session keys, a separate signer, Vanna never holds custody. Stellar testnet, XLM and USDC, with Blend, Aquarius and Soroswap.

Said plainly, because the day demands it: a floor is a defended line, not a guarantee. Liquidation remains possible in extreme conditions. And if a chain halts, so does everything running on it — including us.
